items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Makes trip to locker room Sunday
items.text:
St. Brown headed to the locker room in the first quarter of Sunday's game against the Vikings due to an apparent injury, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Ruled out for rest of Sunday's game
items.text:
Jackson (right thumb) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Bills.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Questionable to return with thumb injury
items.text:

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Back in Sunday's game
items.text:
